sections.leads: From B minor to F♯ minor; perfect cadence in F♯ minor at bar 64

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (6 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 2 (2 times) and the opening of the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 2 (3 times) and a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (5 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (4 times) and the opening of the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 2, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1 (3 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to A major; perfect cadence in F♯ minor at bar 69; perfect cadence in F♯ minor at bar 76; perfect cadence in C♯ minor at bar 84
